summary: Complete independent audit of all 292 Chinese source units, 23 temporal or active-hint items, and 9 people. Eight legendary-antiquity classifications and four retrospective ancestor references are source-faithful. Emperor Wu’s one claim, one dated event context, and dependent active-date hint incorrectly turn the undated reign reference 武帝 into continuous BC 141–87 personal chronology. No additional dated personal event, birth, death, age, or source-based bound is omitted.

findings.problem: The source phrase 至武帝 identifies Emperor Wu’s reign as the setting of multiple actions, but supplies no regnal year or evidence that he was personally active across the entire BC 141–87 reign. The claim and event startDate therefore overstate the source as a continuous Western interval, and the two matching active hints inherit that error.
findings.action: Replace only these sourceDate contexts and p009’s dependent active-date hints with source-faithful unresolved chronology or a narrower independently evidenced date; preserve the campaign/reorganization event and all non-date content. Rebuild the packet and obtain a fresh independent audit.
